description: Small fixed dataset of research-run scenarios used to regression-test the evaluators in backend/evaluation. Each scenario is self-contained (topic, ranked sources, evidence corpus, verification summary, and a generated report) plus the qualitative verdict a correct evaluator run should reach.

scenarios.description: Evidence, claims, and report all agree; citations resolve to real sources.
scenarios.evidence_text: Solid state battery commercialization has accelerated in 2026 as manufacturers scale pilot production lines. Several companies report energy density improvements of over 40 percent compared to lithium ion cells. Cost per kilowatt hour remains a barrier to mass adoption according to industry analysts.

verification_claims.claim_text: Solid state batteries show energy density improvements of over 40 percent versus lithium ion.

evidence.title: Battery Report
evidence.evidence_text: energy density improvements of over 40 percent compared to lithium ion cells

verification_claims.claim_text: Cost per kilowatt hour remains a barrier to mass adoption.

evidence.title: Solid State Batteries
evidence.evidence_text: Cost per kilowatt hour remains a barrier to mass adoption according to industry analysts

scenarios.report_markdown:
## Introduction
Solid state battery commercialization is progressing in 2026. See https://example.com/battery-report for details.

## Key Findings
Energy density improvements of over 40 percent versus lithium ion cells have been reported. Cost per kilowatt hour remains a barrier to mass adoption.

## Sources
https://example.com/battery-report, https://research.example.org/ssb
key_statistics: Energy density improved over 40 percent compared to lithium ion cells
requirements: Evidence supporting the main research question: solid-state battery commercialization

verification_claims.claim_text: A 2026 breakthrough achieved fault tolerant quantum computing with only ten physical qubits.

evidence.title: Breakthrough
evidence.evidence_text: Researchers announced a stunning leap using only ten physical qubits for full fault tolerance

scenarios.report_markdown:
## Introduction

## Key Findings

## Sources
https://not-a-real-source.example/breakthrough
key_statistics: Fault tolerance achieved with only ten physical qubits
requirements: Evidence supporting the main research question: quantum computing error correction

scenarios.description: Retrieved sources directly disagree about a material claim.
scenarios.evidence_text: Forecast A expects sales growth of 25 percent. Forecast B expects sales growth of 8 percent and cites weaker demand.

verification_claims.claim_text: Electric vehicle sales will grow 25 percent.

scenarios.report_markdown:
## Findings
Sources disagree materially about the sales forecast.
requirements: Direct evidence covering the range and disagreement among electric vehicle sales forecasts.
